Dropping the quadratic term or the 1/2 are the usual algebra traps; quoting v confuses the two kinematic outputs. Neighbouring options fail because they name a different relation, drop a required conversion, or contradict a number given in the stem (GAMSAT.S3.phys.t13#800005). Those traps are not a second live key.

distractor_rationales.A: Omits the (1/2) a t^{2} contribution.
distractor_rationales.C: Forgets the 1/2 in (1/2) a t^{2}.
distractor_rationales.D: Reports the final speed with a metre label.

items.stem: In experiment 800008, a cart on a low-friction rail has initial speed 8 m s^{-1} and constant acceleration 3 m s^{-2}. Speed after 8 s is
